description: Read live results for a HUMAN_EVAL project: Bradley-Terry/Elo leaderboard with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals, head-to-head win-rate matrix, per-criterion score CIs, release-gate status (PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE), and judge-vs-human alignment. Results update as graders work; intervals narrow as more grades arrive. Model identities are visible here by design (graders never see them). Pass format=inspect for an Inspect-compatible JSON eval log. Requires open-label:read scope.
name: opentrain_get_eval_results
